messages:
Alan: Heads-up — after yesterday's routing policy fanout canary we're seeing a spike of SDK-side 409s and misattributed quota hits. Seen in py and go clients.
Mira: ack. can you paste a small example of the failing request?
Alan: our infra logs show a mismatched header negotiation. e.g. request with `X-Rdw-Route` + empty `X-Rdw-Policy` -> router treats as fanout and counts multiple route attempts, causing quota collisions.
Sophia: that sounds like the new fanout codepath expands a single logical request into N behind the router. if the SDK didn't populate policy meta we may be double-billing tenants.
DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-23T09:12:07 — rollout: routing-fanout-v2 canary -> 10% -> success metrics pending.
Kev: which SDK versions report this? we need exact stacks to decide rollback vs shim.
Alan: py 1.8.2, go 0.9.7, ts clients not seeing it yet. surfaces when clients send route header but no quota-context header.
Mira: mitigation idea: router reject fanout for requests lacking quota header (`X-Rdw-Quota`) to stop multi-counts. but that's behavior-changey.
Ryan: alternative: small SDK patch that adds conservative fallback header `X-Rdw-Quota: unset-sdk-fallback` so router treats as single-path and logs. less risky than router-side policy change.
Lisa: +1 for SDK patch first — quicker rollout and avoids touching server semantics with unknown side effects.
Sophia: agree. telemetry first though: we need to know how widespread missing headers are. current console chart aggregates routes and doubles numbers — hard to tell.
Alan: exported a sample (2k requests) — ~12% lack quota header. those correspond to noisy 409s.
Kev: parallel tracks: (1) emergency SDK patch to set quota fallback when missing and (2) router quick-guard that logs+rejects explicit fanout if quota missing. SDK patch is top priority.
Mira: DevEx — assemble py+go releases with header fallback. patch: ````python
# py sdk snippet
if 'X-Rdw-Quota' not in headers:
    headers['X-Rdw-Quota'] = 'unset-sdk-fallback'
```` and Go: `http.Header.Set("X-Rdw-Quota","unset-sdk-fallback")`.
Ryan: prototyping go patch now; will add env var SKIP_QUOTA_FALLBACK for customers managing headers.
Lisa: console impact: add a temporary dashboard tile showing requests with fallback header so we can track uptake.
Sophia: I'll add telemetry dimension `sdk_quota_fallback=true/false` in routing pipeline. low effort.
Alan: router logs: add one-line include original client id for reconciliation.
Kev: timeline: py/go patch + release in ~2 hours if no blocker; rollouts 5% -> 50%. Router guard hotfix if errors persist after 4 hours.
Mira: CS comms? Not unless billing changes; post short status in #customer-success about potential quota count blips.
DeployBot: canary rollout scheduled: py 1.8.3 -> 05:00 UTC, go 0.9.8 -> 05:15 UTC.
Ryan: pushed go patch to branch `hotfix/quota-fallback-go`, CI green. requesting release approval.
Lisa: added dashboard tile and temporary alert (>=1% fallback AND 5xx > baseline) so ops gets pinged.
Sophia: telemetry mapping done, sampling the new dimension now.
Alan: quick local test: `curl -H \"X-Rdw-Route: alpha\" https://api.redwood.example/generate` before patch -> 409; after patch -> 200 and single quota increment.
Mira: good. schedule coordination for rollout windows. after stabilization we need a design doc to prevent future mismatches: either explicit header handshake or router-driven attribute negotiation.
Kev: owner for that doc = Sophia. target in 1 week.
Ryan: releasing go now. release notes: "SDK: add quota-fallback header to avoid unintended routing fanout; add SKIP_QUOTA_FALLBACK env var".
Alan: once stable, deprecate implicit fanout and require explicit route-multiplex token to avoid accidental expansion.
Lisa: creating console ticket to warn when route shows fanout >1 without matching quota header.
Mira: moving thread to postmortems channel if anything goes sideways. otherwise close after final verification. :thumbsup:
